primary: GEO Stage ccRCC, PR2/3/4/5/6/7/8; untreated nonmetastatic primary tissue and adjacent normal; merge multiple tumor regions within donor

excluded_donors.PR9: chemotherapy and thrombus-related metadata; exclude whole donor

sensitivity: BM1/BM2 metastatic-status primary tissues and adjacent normal, kept separate
annotation: Preserve author ano.l1; Tumor means author-annotated tumor, not a new independent CNV call
qc: Author-selected cells are the input; additionally >=200 detected features and mitochondrial fraction <=0.20; author-only sensitivity also reported
aggregation: Raw UMI sums by donor x tissue x broad cell type, CPM from total RNA; detection fractions; donor equal summaries; cells and regions are not independent subjects
raw_audit: Exact barcode match, nonnegative integer counts, match author TotalUMI/gene.num/MT.ratio, sample suffix and GEO condition concordance; retain metadata exclusions
candidates: Existing PCR discovery20 plus historical frozen20, preserve separate set flags and rank; add frozen top input features and canonical marker audit; no reranking
paired_summary: Within five paired primary donors compare author tumor cells in tumor tissue versus proximal tubule cells in adjacent normal: log2((CPM+1)/(CPM+1)), median and individual directions; descriptive, no cell-level p-values
cross_study: Compare equal-donor author_tumor median CPM ranks and broad cell exposure against GSE159115; old study labels remain flagged, never treated as clean reference
prediction_mixture: Secondary descriptive sensitivity on fixed model, same 25/50/75 percent non-tumor RNA mixtures and observed-all cells as prior study; common covered gene universe and mapping re-estimated by scenario; no functional truth
limitations: adjacent normal is not healthy-volunteer tissue
single-cell CPM and bulk TPM are not equivalent
study independence does not prove anonymous donor identities are genetically distinct
expression is not dependency or therapeutic window
